news.title: Fifa sparks tension with demand for tax-free status in UK for Women’s World Cup
news.lede: It also wants exchange-rate fees exemption for 2035. Fifa at loggerheads with UK’s four FAs and government. Fifa is at loggerheads with the UK’s government and four Football Associations over the world governing body’s demands for tax-free status and exemptions from exchange-rate fees at the 2035 Women’s World Cup. The UK bid to host the tournament is due to be ratified at an extraordinary Fifa congress in Zurich on Monday, and the Guardian has learned there is tension behind the scenes over many of Fifa’s requirements, which multiple sources involved in the discussions have indicated will not be met.

news.title: Football fan knocked unconscious by 'martial arts' strike during England match
news.lede: A FOOTBALL fan was knocked unconscious while watching an England World Cup match in Barrow, a court heard. Joseph Winder, of Mill Bank, Barrow, pleaded guilty at the first opportunity to assault occasioning actual bodily harm at South Cumbria Magistrates’ Court. Prosecutor Lee Dacre said the incident took place on June 23 at Barrow Raiders Rugby Club during England’s World Cup qualifier match against Ghana. “The complainant walked towards the defendant in his direction at 8.45pm whilst the match was being streamed on the big screen,” Mr Dacre said.

news.title: Guardiola backs Klopp to return Germany to the top of football
news.lede: Former Manchester City manager Pep Guardiola has praised Jürgen Klopp, describing the German as one of the most prominent figures in football and insisting that his appointment as Germany coach is an important step that could help the team regain its place among the world's leading national sides.Speaking to the Bundesliga magazine, Guardiola said his admiration for Klopp is beyond words, describing the German as an exceptional character who makes the world of football better. He added, as reported by " Sky Sports ": "He is one of the best people in football, and I can't even describe how much I admire him. He is the kind of person and coach who makes the world of football better." Nor did the Spaniard stop at Klopp's personality.

news.title: Football: Jackson and England beaten in WAFF World Cup Last-16
news.lede: Manx amputee footballer, Sean Jackson and the England national amputee football side have suffered defeat in the Last-16 at this year's WAFF World Cup in Mexico. The international squad fell to a 2-1 defeat to Egypt yesterday (18 November), during which England took the lead through Sofyan Filali's first world cup goal. However, Egypt struck back with an equaliser before half-time before adding a second late on to progress to the quarter-final phase. For England, it's not the end of the tournament as they now enter the play-offs for positions 9th to 16th.

news.title: Why Lucas Digne should retire from international football and focus on PSG?
news.lede: Lucas Digne is an interesting topic of discussion during this international break . He wasn't called up to Zidane's recent France squad for the Nations League games against Italy (away) and Türkiye (home), despite being a mainstay under Deschamps.One could argue that missing out on the previous two France squads is a blessing in disguise, as it will motivate him to work harder. One could also argue that it would be harsh if the lasting memory people have of his international career is the penalty that he gave away against Spain in the World Cup semi-final, as he didn't see where Lamine Yamal was. In spite of this, there are several reasons why he should consider retiring from international football.
